title: 3.2.18 Lab: Fix a Function That Prints Instead of Returning
description: A function computes correctly but prints its result, so the caller gets undefined. Fix it to return, and prove the fix with arithmetic. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Run it and read the symptom
steps.instructions: Run the starter. The function prints the area, but the variable that stores the call prints as undefined. That is the tell of a missing return.

steps.title: Find the missing return
steps.instructions: Look at where the function hands its answer to console.log. The function ends without a return, so the call produces undefined.

steps.title: Fix the function
steps.instructions: Change the function so it returns the computed value instead of printing it. Use return, and let the caller print the result.

steps.title: Prove the fix
steps.instructions: Use the returned value in an expression, such as doubling it, and log the result. If the arithmetic works, a real number came back.

requirements.title: area defined
requirements.description: Code defines a function named area. Help: 3.2.16 (Printing Is Not Returning)
requirements.hint: Keep the name area exactly as it is: function area(...) { ... }.

requirements.title: area returns its answer
requirements.description: Inside area there is a return with a value, and area no longer prints with console.log. Help: 3.2.16 (Printing Is Not Returning)
requirements.hint: console.log only shows a value; it does not give it back. Swap it for return. See Reading 3.2.16.

requirements.title: result used in arithmetic
requirements.description: The value that area returns is used in arithmetic (for example doubled), proving a number came back. Help: 3.2.16 (Printing Is Not Returning)
requirements.hint: Prove a number came back by using the call in arithmetic, such as doubling area(3, 4). Reading 3.2.16 shows why this works.

requirements.title: results are logged
requirements.description: Code calls console.log. Help: 3.2.16 (Printing Is Not Returning)
requirements.hint: Log what you print on the outside, around the call, for example console.log(area(3, 4));

requirements.title: area hands back the number and prints nothing
requirements.description: Called on its own, area(width, height) gives back width times height and prints nothing itself. Help: 3.2.16 (Printing Is Not Returning)
requirements.hint: area must return the number (return width * height) and must not call console.log itself: the caller does the printing.

Write each note for THIS student's own code: in a not-met note, name the exact line or name in their code that causes the problem (quote at most a few words of it), say in plain words what it does now versus what the criterion needs, and give one concrete next thing to try, but do NOT write the corrected code. In a met note, say in one short phrase what in their code satisfied it. Do not use generic praise.
